cases.input: Headcount under method A and population P1 changes to headcount under method B and population P2 while phenomenon, quantity kind and statistical unit type remain unchanged.
cases.expect: Metric identity remains; a new immutable DefinitionVersion is created and defaults to non-comparable until an explicit verdict is published.

cases.input: One reporting period has no observation.
cases.expect: The period remains missing or unknown and is never substituted with zero.

cases.input: Historical source data is recalculated under a successor definition.
cases.expect: New observations pin the successor version; old observations remain unchanged.

cases.input: A semi-additive metric is summed over an unsupported time dimension.
cases.expect: Aggregation fails closed under the dimension rule.

cases.input: Person headcount observations are summed with FTE observations.
cases.expect: Aggregation is refused because quantity kind, statistical unit and definition version are not commensurable.

cases.input: A metric is aggregated across a dimension with no additivity declaration.
cases.expect: Aggregation is refused because undeclared is not additive.

cases.input: Two versions differ but an approved restatement method and evidence exist.
cases.expect: Comparability is comparable-with-restatement and references the method and evidence.

cases.input: A published mapping restates four historical periods under a successor definition.
cases.expect: Four new observation vintages are created and every prior observation remains resolvable.

cases.input: A target bound to definition V1 is evaluated silently with V2 observations.
cases.expect: Evaluation is refused until the target is explicitly rebound or a declared restatement is applied.

cases.input: A headcount-person Metric is changed to an FTE Metric.
cases.expect: A new Metric identity is required; correspondence may be recorded but DefinitionVersion continuity is rejected.

cases.input: A comparability declaration says comparable-with-restatement but has no pinned method or evidence.
Two active definition sources claim equal authority for the same Metric and effective scope.
cases.expect: Automatic merge and winner selection are refused; the conflict is surfaced.

cases.input: Metric-level verdict is non-comparable while one facet claims comparable.
cases.expect: The facet may not widen the aggregate verdict and comparison is refused.

cases.input: A superseded DefinitionVersion is later withdrawn and tombstoned.
cases.expect: Its identifier, digest, predecessor and provenance remain resolvable.
